title: Genes and compounds that increase type VII collagen expression as potential treatments for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa
model: N/TERT keratinocytes with a COL7A1-tdTomato reporter, genome-wide CRISPRa (Calabrese set A, 56,762 guides)
contrast: Top-10% tdTomato sort vs plasmid library (1 vs 1; screening-level)
paper_method: Guide fold change over plasmid converted to Z-scores; genes with several enriched guides
paper_calls: 1,544 enriched guides; DENND4B and TYROBP as top genes (COL7A1 positive control), both validated
barcs_calls: 3 genes at FDR 0.10 (DENND4B, TYROBP, COL7A1); no replicates, overdispersion pooled from 477 non-targeting guides
verdict: BARCS calls exactly the paper's two validated activators and the COL7A1 positive control and nothing else; the paper's other top guide-level Z-scores rest on single guides and are not gene-level hits.
